answer: A new orchard anchors in vertex only when two existing holders, from separate branches, each stake yarrow behind it, and a holder may sponsor once, its slot consumed. Admission therefore needs a binary tree of distinct earlier identities: a thousand fakes demand near two thousand paid ones beneath them, each having burnt its sponsors' yarrow. No batch satisfies it, since sponsors cannot be cloned or reused, and the bill is yarrow at risk plus the recursive stake of every sponsor in the chain, attached to each vertex anchor. It breaks if slots are resold or collusion refunds stake.
